note: Unit prices only, extracted from the vendors' own pricing pages. Every number carries the page it came from and the date it was read. This file is the data layer: the CLI, the MCP server and any page are renderers of it.
disclosure: Links marked affiliate are a9n9's affiliate links: a9n9 earns a commission if you buy through them. Prices are the vendors' own and are not affected.

firecrawl.name: Firecrawl
firecrawl.buyer_offer: New users get 10% off their first purchase through the affiliate link (stated on partners.dub.co/firecrawl).
firecrawl.credit_rule: 1 credit = 1 page scraped or 1 crawl page. JSON format and prompt-injection checks add 4 credits per page.
traps: The '$16/month' figure is the annual-billed rate ($190/year), not the monthly price of $19.
Searches and pages share one credit balance; a search is 2 credits, so '5,000 credits' is 2,500 searches on Hobby.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
traps: Two price lists disagree ~2.3x: /pricing/api bills dollars per character ($0.08/1k), while the marketing FAQ describes credits (121,000 Creator for $22) which is $0.18/1k.
The API ladder is flat: $990/12.375M = $0.080/1k, i.e. no volume discount. Buying a bigger plan does not lower the unit price.
First-month promos (Starter $3, Creator $11) are not prices; list price is $6/$22.

deepgram.name: Deepgram
traps: Deepgram's $200 credit is the free tier; it expires, so it is not a price.
Self-hosted/BYO-key rates are ~33% cheaper than the standard per-minute rate and are easy to miss.

computed_facts.el_agent_vs_dg_standard: ElevenLabs agent minutes cost $0.080 vs Deepgram $0.075 per minute: 6.7% more per agent minute, while per character ElevenLabs is 5.3x Deepgram Aura-1 ($0.015/1k) and 2.7x Aura-2 ($0.030/1k).
computed_facts.chars_per_minute_range: Characters per spoken minute swings 600-1,000 depending on speaker and pacing: a 67% swing in any per-character estimate.
